import.title: Import Questions
import.upload_hint: Click to upload a CSV file
import.how_it_works: The first CSV row must be headers. The importer recognizes question_type/type, title/question, option_a/A, correct_answer/answer, points/marks, explanation/analysis/rationale, question_image, and option_a_image. You can also place all options in one options cell, for example A. Beijing; B. Shanghai. Correct answers can be A, B, A;C, 1, 2, or the full option text. If type is empty, the system infers single choice, multiple choice, true/false, or written response from the options and answer.
import.limit_hint: Up to 20 questions can be imported at once. CSV and TSV files are supported; save Excel files as CSV before uploading. For images, enter accessible image URLs; local image files can be uploaded in the editor after import.
import.limit_notice: Up to {max} questions can be imported at once. The first {max} questions were read and {remaining} were skipped.
import.ai_prompt_desc: Copy this prompt to an AI tool, then paste your raw questions. The AI can format them into an import-ready CSV.
import.csv_image_note: CSV cannot embed image files. Put accessible https image URLs in the image columns, or import the text first and upload local images inside the editor.
import.ai_prompt_text:
Please convert the questions I provide into a CSV that can be imported into Ailaeclass.

Output rules:
1. Return CSV only. Do not add explanations before or after the CSV.
2. Use this exact header row:
题型,题目,题目图片,选项A,选项A图片,选项B,选项B图片,选项C,选项C图片,选项D,选项D图片,选项E,选项E图片,选项F,选项F图片,答案,分数,答案解析
3. Supported question types: 单选题, 多选题, 判断题, 问答题.
4. For 单选题, the answer must be one option, such as A.
5. For 多选题, separate answers with semicolons, such as A;C;D.
6. For 判断题, use 选项A=对 and 选项B=错, and set 答案 to 对 or 错.
7. For 问答题, leave option columns and 答案 empty, and put marking guidance in 答案解析.
8. 分数 must be a number. Use 1 if no score is provided.
9. If a question or option needs an image, put an accessible https image URL in 题目图片 or 选项图片 columns. CSV cannot embed local image files.
10. Escape commas, quotes, and line breaks correctly according to CSV rules.

Now convert the following content into this CSV format:

hover.summary: Hover control is stable with little position drift. A brief altitude sink occurred during a gust but stayed within the safety threshold.

route.title: Rectangular Route
route.subtitle: Checks waypoint accuracy, heading drift on straight legs, and corner control.
route.summary: Waypoint pass rate is high. The third leg shows slight weaving correction; improve direction holding on straight segments.

landing.title: Return-To-Land
landing.subtitle: Checks return path, descent rate, landing accuracy, and safety actions.
landing.summary: Return path is accurate. Descent rate is high in the final 6 seconds, while landing point error remains within the passing range.
